newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end up on gains by weighted scrips.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end up on gains by weighted scrips.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher on gains by weighted scrips which, brokers said, had offset late-hour selling pressure in the market.
"Weighted issues helped the market despite a selling pressure that brought down majority of the shares traded," said a broker.
The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange rose 17.95 points or 1.28 percent at 1,608.98 on turnover of 186.5 million taka.

Of the 110 issues traded, 58 closed down, 48 ended up and four were unchanged. Bangladesh Tobacco Company gained 3.86 taka to 237.93, Beximco Pharmaceuticals was up 17.56 to 153.07, IDLC lost 105.38 to 4,744.62 and Chittagong Cement Clinker shed 12.62 to 3,882.80.
